question:
A vessel contains two immiscible transparent liquids: an oil layer of thickness $6\,\text{cm}$ (refractive index $n_o$ unknown) floating on water of thickness $12\,\text{cm}$ (refractive index $n_w=\tfrac{4}{3}$). A mark at the bottom is viewed normally from air through the top surface.

The apparent depth of the mark from the top surface is found to be $13\,\text{cm}$.

A thin plane-parallel glass slab of refractive index $n_g=\tfrac{3}{2}$ and thickness $x$ is now placed on top of the oil such that it is in optical contact (no air gap). The mark is again viewed normally from air, and the apparent depth from the **top surface of the glass slab** is measured to be $13.5\,\text{cm}$.

The value of $x$ (in cm) is:
